title: Safe routes to school program special fund; establishment.
bodyHtml:
§291C-4  Safe routes to school program special fund; establishment.  There shall be established in the state treasury the safe routes to school program special fund, into which shall be deposited:

     (1)  Assessments collected for speeding in a school zone, pursuant to section 291C-104;

     (2)  Safe routes to school program surcharges collected in accordance with sections 291-16 and 291C-5;

     (3)  Moneys collected from state reserved parking space enforcement fines pursuant to sections 291-57 and 291-72;

    [(4)] The surcharge collected pursuant to section 249-37; and

    [(5)] Fines collected for street parking restrictions pursuant to section 291C-116. [L 2012, c 317, pt of §2; am L Sp 2021, c 9, §62; am L 2025, c 112, §4, c 171, §3, and c 212, §5]
